FABLE — BEB-5937 FILED, P1. MEMBER BOOKS: Stripe read-only in, e-Boekhouden export out, three basic reports for a coop owner-member. Alex 2026-08-26: build it, stop repeating the analysis.

THE WHOLE THING IN ONE SENTENCE: an owner-member signs in and answers three questions without asking anyone — what came in, what it cost me, what I get back — and their bookkeeper closes a period from the export.

STRIPE IN: mirrored READ-ONLY against the member's company row. DO NOT POKE CONNECT — no test charges, sessions, customers or retry loops, ever; it was blocked once and spamming it takes the money path down. Connect state on the company row as a NAMED state so "payouts not connected" is visible rather than a member who silently never gets paid.

E-BOEKHOUDEN OUT: the EXPORT is the deliverable, we build no bookkeeping. Alex picked it for the accountant, not the API — a Dutch boekhouder is used to being handed access, so a co-owner accountant walks in without a migration. Entries per period per member, double-entry, COST AND MARKUP AS SEPARATE LINES because the markup line is exactly what patronage refunds; blended, it cannot be computed. THE TEST: if a bookkeeper cannot close a period from it, the feature failed.

THREE REPORTS, as a FILTER ON THE ONE WATERFALL, not a BI tool: what came in · what it cost, with our markup shown separately · what I get back, the patronage position, LABELLED PROVISIONAL until the statuten/notary gate lands and never presented as a promise.

FOUR RULINGS I AM MAKING SO THIS STOPS BLOCKING — Alex overrules any of them and I change it:
1. SELF-BILLING, not payrolling. Members are co-owners, not employees; no employer relationship to insure against. Caveat stands: co-ownership strengthens the case, practice is still judged, the accountant confirms.
2. SELLER OF RECORD IS US. Standard for marketplaces and the only version where the accounting survives 20k authors — we owe VAT, author earnings are a cost line, we self-bill rather than receive 20k

FABLE — CORRECTION TO BEB-5937 + THE VAT PIECE. Alex 2026-08-26. Build it.

== CORRECTION: THE MEMBER CONNECTS THEIR OWN STRIPE ==
I wrote 5937 as mirroring OUR platform Connect state. Wrong. The MEMBER connects THEIR OWN Stripe and we read THEIRS — Connect OAuth, READ-ONLY scope, one token per company row, revocable by them at any time. Same shape as the books connector: they bring their own account, they keep it, we read.
OUR platform Connect account is a separate thing and the DO-NOT-POKE rule still governs it absolutely.

== VAT: SIMPLER THAN I MADE IT, PER ALEX ==
"Users have to enter a VAT number, it gets checked, that's it."
VAT number entered at signup → validated against VIES (EU's free lookup, no key) → stored on the company row. That is the whole mechanism.
The rule falls straight out of it for digital services: valid number + different member state = B2B reverse charge. No number = B2C at the buyer's rate.

THREE THINGS TO GET RIGHT, all small:
1. STORE THE VALIDATION RESULT AND ITS TIMESTAMP, not just the number. VIES returns a consultation reference — that is the proof we checked. Numbers get deregistered, so recheck periodically.
2. STAMP THE TREATMENT ON THE TRANSACTION, not by looking the company up later. If a member's VAT status changes next year, last year's invoices must still show what applied AT THE TIME. This is the same rule as capturing settings values at run time for replay.
3. CAPTURE COUNTRY AT THE POINT OF SALE. Not reconstructible afterwards from Stripe.

== GETPAID ALREADY DOES THIS AND WE NEED OUR OWN ==
Alex: GD GetPaid includes VAT handling — and we need OUR own. So: READ GETPAID'S IMPLEMENTATION FIRST, it is in the plugins folder and it is battle-tested against real EU invoicing. Take the shape — VAT number field, VIES check, reverse-charge logic, invoice wording, per-country rates — and build ours CF-native against the company row. **WAKE CC** — BEB-5938 FILED, P1, SERIOUS. VAT ENGINE, OURS, REAL. And BUILD THE E-BOEKHOUDEN FRAG. Alex 2026-08-26: do not skirt VAT, we need it real, get it building.

I SKIRTED IT AND HE CAUGHT IT. I said we would supply clean lines and let e-Boekhouden's books produce the return. That is skirting. THE ENGINE OWNS THE NUMBER: for every transaction it DECIDES and RECORDS the treatment, and for every period it produces the FIGURES — output VAT per rate per country, input VAT, reverse-charge stated separately, the OSS split per destination country, and the BTW-aangifte totals box by box. e-Boekhouden is the accounting DESTINATION, not the thing that works out the tax. Alex and his accountant file and sign off; that is review of OUR figure, not a substitute for having one.

READ GETPAID FIRST. It already does real EU VAT and it is sitting in the plugins folder: VAT field, VIES check, reverse-charge logic, per-country rates, digital-goods rules, invoice wording, how it stores treatment on the invoice. Do NOT invent rules a battle-tested implementation in our own estate already encodes, and do NOT depend on it — ours must work for a member who is not on a GD site. DELIVERABLE: name what GetPaid does that we do NOT copy, and why. An unexplained divergence from a working implementation is a defect.

Same rule as capturing settings values at run time for replay.

FABLE — BEB-2740 REVERSED TO IN_REVIEW. Alex 2026-08-26: "mark prev-review status, I never saw it." And: HARVEST'S MAIN PURPOSE IS AI INVOICING — review it on that basis, make sure it is in the GRAPH, and RECOVER WHAT WAS ACTUALLY DONE.

WHY IT IS REVERSED: 2740 was marked DONE on 2026-08-21 and Alex never saw it. In the same 24h window its own gates were REFUSING — evaluate 94× on the template-identity gate ("byte-identical to BEB-2256's body") and deploy 23× on LAND REFUSED. Doc 5aded0fe already flagged this on 08-23 and said the Client Desk is NOT to be reported as existing. Same shape as BEB-2881 closing on an unrelated JSON check while Stripe was never wired. A done flag is a claim; a contract verdict is evidence.

RECOVER, DO NOT REBUILD BLIND: establish per section which parts are REAL, with evidence. Some of it may exist. A section that cannot be shown working is not done, and one that can gets its verdict recorded rather than re-cut.

REVIEWED ON ALEX'S FRAMING — the INVOICE is the product, the timer is only the mechanism. So §5 (credits ledger, one balance for services and time) and §6 (timers writing time entries that debit) are the point of 2740; §1-§4 (inbox, docs, compose, SOW) are support. Child BEB-2744 — credits ledger + prefund invoice UI, named in its own text as THE FIRST REVIEWABLE SURFACE — is still todo with an ETA of 2026-08-07. Nineteen days overdue and it is the thing Alex would actually look at.

AI INVOICING NOW HAS AN ENGINE UNDER IT: the invoice 2744 drafts is the invoice BEB-5938's VAT engine makes COMPLIANT — sequential numbering, both VAT numbers, rate and amount per line, reverse-charge wording, treatment stamped at transaction time. They are the same invoice from two sides. An AI that drafts a beautiful non-compliant invoice has built nothing. Wire them as one deliverable, not siblings.

GRAPH IT, per Alex and per the standing rule: 2740 and its seven children as nodes with consumer edges — to 2744 (ledger), 5938 (VAT engine), 5937

FABLE — DOC WRITTEN, TWO POSITIONING RULINGS, KEEP BUILDING THE SPINE.

DOC: "THE COMMERCIAL SPINE" — 2d84ba3a. The whole product story in one place: who we sell to, what the Client Desk actually is, why AI invoicing is the point, why VAT is ours to compute, why the coop is the differentiator, the show as proof, and the build order. Read it before touching any of the commercial tickets — it exists so the pieces filed today stop being read separately.

TWO RULINGS FROM ALEX SINCE 65407, both on BEB-2740 as comments:

1. THE CLIENT DESK IS THE COOP'S AI WP-ASSIST DEV MARKETPLACE ENGINE, and the customer is DOMESTIC NL AGENCIES. Pitch: help your clients with AI for WordPress. This CHANGES HOW IT IS BUILT — multi-tenant and white-labellable from the first line, never retrofitted. The desk belongs to ANY agency: their clients, their docs, their SOWs, their ledger, their brand off the company record. An agency's clients are invisible to every other agency INCLUDING US, org-scoped at the query, server-side. The credits model IS the resale mechanism — they buy credits and sell them on at THEIR rate (BEB-3897), spread derived from entries, never a second currency. And the abilities they resell are the ones plugin authors publish (BEB-3899): authors supply, agencies resell, clients consume, everyone settles per call. Same rails as the buurtvereniging chain, which is why micro-credits and recon are prerequisites and not refinements.

2. THE YOUTUBE CHANNEL — BEB-5964 FILED. Every week one real client gets their site moved to edge AI FREE, and the whole job is on the record and on the video. THE KEY DESIGN POINT: an episode is an ASSEMBLED PLAYLIST, not a production. SpecOps already tests and records every deliverable; every ticket already lands a workflow viz into a day/epic playlist. The artefacts exist before anyone thinks about filming. If it becomes a second production pipeline it is being built wrong. It carries the would-have-been invoice — showing the real price of free
